pytest-bdd collects all 604 scenarios with no hand-maintained list; 17 spec tags registered as marks; validate_spec wired in as a test. Two review rounds closed nine execution-verified routes by which the suite could go green while the spec was silenced, hollowed or partly unread — spec size, step count (1898), executed-vs-skipped counts, deferral level, recursive step discovery, and hooks refused in step modules are each pinned by a guard test.

SQLite store for the seven DOMAIN.md entities: generated DDL, 12 closed sets derived from README.md's own tables with CHECK enforcement, ordered child collections, data-root-relative paths guarded on write and resolvable on read. Review found a data-integrity defect — saves() never rolled back, so a refused row became durable on the next successful write — plus five Important findings; all fixed and pinned by regression tests that assert a refusal left no row, checked through a second connection.

Segment.distribution_confirmed records per-approval consent as a tri-state: null never asked, false declined, true confirmed. Verified unlosable — all three round-trip identity-preserved and a CHECK refuses anything else through raw SQL.

Segment.publication_date and label, both nullable because required is a condition of publishing. The DDL generator gained a real date type rather than reusing datetime, since the filename convention is a calendar date.

Notification modelled with every field its feature file's table names, state closed on the four verbatim values, subject as recording_id plus nullable segment_id following Artifact and Job. Delivery concerns disclosed in a Not stored note rather than silently omitted.
Block.speaker_profile_ids became Block.speaker_matches carrying a similarity per link. Named similarity rather than confidence because this model reserves confidence for a derived high/medium/low.
DOMAIN.md's Recording state count corrected to ten; Block types verified genuinely eleven. A new drift test parses the stated count out of the field row, which the previous test never checked.

Proposal is 1:N with a supersession chain. Decided on the live requirement rather than the archival one: showing a new machine proposal beside a reviewer's edit needs two Proposals for one Segment simultaneously, which no 1:1 can hold. Boundaries deliberately stay on the Segment; the consequence and the missing processing log are both filed.

LogEntry models the processing log as one entity: state transitions, job attempts, human actions and boundary sets in one ordered table, with correlation_id NOT NULL so an entry can be tied to the application logs. One table rather than three because the spec expands one log and calls its unit an entry, and because one query then returns the whole log in time order.

Boundary history lives on the log, so a superseded Proposal gets its cuts back via proposal_id and a reviewer's adjustment (which has no Proposal) sits in the same ordered history. Segment.proposed_punch_in was dropped rather than kept: it duplicated the machine's suggestion two rows above the model's own rule against a second source of truth, and nothing could have detected the drift.

Proposal.punch_in_candidates carries Candidate(timecode, considered_because). Deliberately not the Evidence shape: the scenario gives exactly two facts, Evidence.implies would be empty, and reusing it would make every evidence entry look like a jumpable boundary when most are not. Punch-in only, since punch-out has no such scenario.

Both halves of the spec audited exhaustively: 460 scenarios across all 34 feature files, 181 interface/operations/notifications and 279 ingestion/analysis/processing. Result: 21 certain gaps and 19 arguable, all filed. Five entities are unmodelled (skipped object keys, events belonging to no Recording, the reviewer, the accuracy corpus, retained suite results); Segment has no span distinct from its punch points, which makes a validation rule three interface scenarios depend on unimplementable; and five DOMAIN.md statements are stale or falsified by scenarios. Seven feature files were confirmed fully covered by the current model.

Segment carries span_start_seconds/span_end_seconds, required because every Segment the spec creates has both ends. Two invariants deliberately deferred rather than dropped: punch points inside the span (sp-6kh, amended to name it) and overlap rejection on extension, which compares two rows (sp-wpw). segment_proposal.feature:206 resolved as not a contradiction — a merge and a hand-drawn Segment start coincident; a proposed Segment's span is detected and normally wider.
Segment.summary, distinct from Notification.summary which is composed delivery text.

Recording carries integrated loudness, true peak and loudness range with units in the field names, so the render's normalization inputs cannot be confused with dynamic_range_db or with the render's own target.

Recording carries ordered per-channel levels, the channel-or-mix decision, and whether a human answered it — the render blocks on that answer so it cannot be recomputed. mono_source is open text, since the scenarios name one value and declare no vocabulary; a closed set would have been invented spec.
ARTIFACT_KINDS gains envelope, the first stage's output that every later stage re-reads and that the do-not-recompute promise depends on.

Segment.confirmed_speaker_profile_id with a foreign key, so a human's correction of who preached survives a re-analysis that re-ranks the machine's similarity scores. distribution_confirmed was the consent half; this is the identity half.

SkippedObject keyed on the object key, with a CHECK-closed reason taken verbatim from the spec's own Examples table. Keyed on the key rather than a generated id because three of the four reasons describe keys no Recording row can exist for, and because a scheduled re-scan should correct its row rather than append one per scan. Reviewer attacked and approved the design: the scenarios name a set of objects and record the reason singular, so a timestamp would be a field no scenario forces.

Discovery: one entity for scans and webhook receipts, since the health view renders them as one thing with one shared attribute. No Alert entity — the scenarios give an alert no fields of its own, so Notification.recording_id became nullable instead. Review proved that relaxation had turned an enforced guarantee into caller discipline; a new Presence primitive restores it in the schema and also forbids a webhook carrying a scan-only failure or a failed scan reporting discoveries.

Recording.warnings[] holds seven named conditions from a closed set, ordered. Closed because later behaviour reads the strings — the render gates on one and the detail view explains another specifically — unlike Notification.kind and LogEntry.kind, which nothing branches on. Four conditions excluded as derivable from the emptiness metrics and duration.
source clipping detected is a value in Recording.warnings[] rather than its own field; the Segment-side 'source was clipped' derives from it.

Review found the original three were short by two: 'no clean cut point found at punch-in' and its punch-out twin are quoted in the Gherkin and are NOT derivable from the Proposal's hard difficulty, which also grades noise near the cut and music under the first words.

Fixed: logprobs/top_logprobs on the ollama generate body makes qwen3.6:35b-mlx byte-identical for byte-identical input. Sampler settings and num_ctx were both ruled out by measurement; qwen3:4b varied too, placing it in ollama 0.34.0's decode path. Verified independently — 9 identical invocations gave 8x -0.096 s and one -73.196 s, the outlier being the first call after a regime change, which is the disclosed within-regime limit. Larger finding: FINDINGS' dev configuration ranking (2.20 / 3.76 / 4.64 s) is entirely reproduced by re-running ONE configuration six times, so the ordering measured noise. Honest pinned figure is found 88%, median punch-in 4.64 s.

Answered: the punch-in is a distribution and is not pinnable in this codebase. It is the model's own number (model_segments[0].punch_in equalled a coalesced teaching-block start 65/65, so the seed rule is consistent and the seed choice is never the disagreement); what varies is the block table, and the table is a function of ollama host state — warm prefix cache vs cold prefill vs post-reload, each reproducible within itself, which is what produced the false pin. logprobs fixed nothing. Trustworthy figures: median |punch-in| 2.88 s over 65 draws, envelope 1.85–7.38 s, three of eight able to land 73–106 s out; median |punch-out| 0.34 s, single-valued on 7 of 8. Only remaining architectural option is the structured strategy, unmeasured and worse on dev.

Dead, measured rather than assumed. An oracle picking the best of three draws moves the dev median 3.47 to 3.41 s and changes no recording's within-5 s verdict. Worse, the MODAL draw is the wrong one on both recordings where the gap is large — 20260503 answers +105.99 s six times against -6.71 s twice, and 20260531 answers -74.67 s five times against +1.33 s three times — so a majority vote or median-of-n picks the bad mode in exactly the two cases a selector would exist for. The deferred agreement signal survives only as an attention badge: it flags the three recordings with a >70 s alternative but cannot say which is right, and misses 20260628 whose punch-out is 1686 s early and never moves. Cut difficulty remains the better v1 signal.
